children: Westwater reported a Q3 2026 net loss of approximately $4.4M, or $0.03 per share, versus approximately $9.8M, or $0.12 per share, in Q3 2025. Nine-month net loss was approximately $13.4M versus $16.4M a year earlier.
The loss narrowed year over year; the company attributed the decrease primarily to lower losses related to Convertible Notes repaid in full during the quarter.
The year-to-date loss also narrowed, though the company cited higher permitting and other operating costs as offsets.
EXIM approved a $25M direct loan for Kellyton Phase I
The approval is a financing step for the plant, but the release does not state that the loan has been funded.
Signed an LOI for customer offtake
The letter of intent is not described as a binding offtake contract; commercial commitment remains unconfirmed.

This is an early-stage development story, with Coosa permitting and Kellyton plant financing, construction and customer qualification still underway. Binding offtake agreements, loan funding and progress toward Kellyton commissioning would provide the next meaningful updates.
